name: Further Instructions
summary: Sputtervalve carries an order from Undermine to Ziz Fizziks in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle, the gnome engineer hired by Mogul Razdunk, must be eliminated.

sections.title: Corporate Disapproval
sections.body: The Venture Company’s hiring of Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle has stirred trouble among Undermine’s rulers. Mogul Razdunk brought the gnome engineer into the company, and word of it reached the Trade Princes. Director Riddlevox told Sputtervalve to intervene quietly. Sputtervalve believes the order comes from the highest trade authorities, so he passes the work to Ziz Fizziks, the operative nearest the scene.

sections.title: Secrets of Dun Morogh
sections.body: Ziz Fizziks welcomes the order to kill Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Goblin engineers disdain their gnome rivals, and Gerenzo has a past that makes him especially volatile. Before joining the Venture Company, he was a head engineer in Gnomeregan and worked on a top-secret project that Undermine’s spies could not fully uncover. The project reportedly ended in catastrophe, exploding in the engineers’ faces. Now Gerenzo sells his dangerous expertise to the Venture Company in Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Sputtervalve is a goblin operative under Director Riddlevox. He carries directives from Undermine and passes contracts to field agents like Ziz Fizziks.

faq.q: Why do the Trade Princes care about Gerenzo?
faq.answer: The Trade Princes of Undermine disapprove of Mogul Razdunk hiring an outside gnome engineer. They see the hire as a threat to goblin industrial dominance and a source of unwelcome scrutiny.

faq.q: What secret project did Gerenzo work on?
faq.answer: Gerenzo worked as a lead engineer on a classified project in Gnomeregan. Goblin spies could not uncover its purpose, and it reportedly ended in disaster, exploding in the engineers’ faces.
Ziz Fizziks is in the Stonetalon Mountains, watching the Venture Company’s local logging and mining efforts while carrying out corporate contracts.

faq.q: Why is Ziz Fizziks eager to kill Gerenzo?
faq.answer: Ziz Fizziks shares the goblins’ professional hatred of gnomes and sees Gerenzo as a dangerous rival. Gerenzo’s experiments in Dun Morogh ended in disaster.
Mogul Razdunk leads the Venture Company. He hired Gerenzo, defying trade etiquette in Undermine and prompting the Trade Princes to push for Gerenzo’s elimination.

angles.text: As a gnome, you hear that Gerenzo was a senior engineer in Gnomeregan. His secret experiment ended in a catastrophic explosion that struck the engineers involved.
As an engineer, you see the rivalry between gnome and goblin engineering turn from disputes over design patents to corporate assassination.
